definition: GPT Image is a series of image generation and editing models developed by OpenAI.
details: A text-to-image variant of the GPT family, it uses deep learning methodologies to generate digital images from natural language descriptions or images precisely. As the successor to DALL-E, GPT Image is native to ChatGPT as ChatGPT Images and available through the API. Upon release in March 2025, GPT Image went viral on social media, particularly for its capability of generating images in the style of Studio Ghibli. GPT Image is also available with Microsoft Copilot and Apple Intelligence as well.

explainer.lead: GPT Image is OpenAI's family of models for creating and editing images from written instructions, with an existing image optionally supplied as a starting point. It brings image generation into ChatGPT and other products, so people can request visual changes in ordinary language.

tiers.eli5: GPT Image is like an artist who follows your written directions: you describe a picture, or hand over a picture and explain what to change, and it makes a new one. It became widely noticed in March 2025 when people used it to make pictures resembling Studio Ghibli's style.
tiers.practitioner: Use GPT Image through ChatGPT Images or the OpenAI API by supplying a natural-language prompt and, for editing, an input image. It is also exposed through Microsoft Copilot and Apple Intelligence. Write prompts that clearly distinguish the desired content, style, and edits; its March 2025 release also showed how a recognizable style request can drive rapid adoption and controversy.
tiers.paperLevel: Formally, GPT Image can be described as a learned mapping fθ: (t, i?) → x, where t is a natural-language description, i is an optional input image, and x is a generated or edited digital image. It is an OpenAI deep-learning model series in the GPT family, positioned as the successor to DALL-E and released in March 2025.

explainer.example: A user uploads a room photo and writes, “Turn this into a watercolor illustration while keeping the furniture layout.” GPT Image uses both the picture and the instruction to produce an edited digital image.

usedIn.name: ChatGPT Images
usedIn.detail: Provides GPT Image natively inside ChatGPT for image generation and editing.

usedIn.name: OpenAI API
usedIn.detail: Makes GPT Image available for application integrations.

usedIn.name: Microsoft Copilot
usedIn.detail: Offers access to GPT Image within Microsoft's assistant.

usedIn.name: Apple Intelligence
usedIn.detail: Includes GPT Image among its available image capabilities.

components.name: Text prompt: describes the desired image or edit
Input image: an optional starting image
GPT Image: generates or edits the visual output
Output image: the resulting digital image

flow: The user supplies a natural-language instruction
An existing image may accompany the instruction
GPT Image processes the generation or editing request
The system returns a digital image
explainer.origin: OpenAI released GPT Image in March 2025. It quickly spread on social media, especially through images generated in the style of Studio Ghibli.
explainer.lineage: GPT Image is a text-to-image variant of the GPT family and the successor to DALL-E. Its product forms include ChatGPT Images and API access, with additional availability in Microsoft Copilot and Apple Intelligence.
explainer.whyItMatters: It combines image creation and instruction-based editing within widely used assistants and an API. Its viral Studio Ghibli-style outputs also demonstrated how quickly generated imagery can capture public attention.

diagram.caption: A prompt, optionally paired with an image, passes through GPT Image to produce a digital image.
